The '''''New Star''''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] that served as part of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. [[Commander/Legends|Commanded]] by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Miech Conar]], it was assigned to accompany the [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] [[Shipment 1037]] to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that [[Standard year/Legends|year]]. While it and the convoy were en route, they were met by the ''[[Far Orbit]]'', a seemingly Imperial [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] that had come to help protect the convoy. However, as the ''Far Orbit'' was actually an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]], it led an Alliance strike force to capture the convoy somewhere in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]' [[Ringali Shell]]. In the resulting [[Hijacking of Shipment 1037|battle]], the ''New Star'' was captured.

==Description==
The ''New Star'' was an [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]]<ref name="Orbit" /> produced by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]].<ref name="X" /> Measuring 300 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length,<ref name="Magic" /> the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] had at least one [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]] installed, and possessed an armament of twelve [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]], twelve smaller [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], and two [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]]. The ''New Star'' carried twelve [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] and had a full complement of [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] and [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]]. It also had enough room to house two [[Platoon/Legends|platoons]] of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], besides the crew.<ref name="Orbit" />

==History==
The ''New Star'' was [[Commander/Legends|commanded]] by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Miech Conar]] and was serving as an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]]<ref name="Orbit" /> by [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{FarOrbitDate}}</ref> at the [[Time/Legends|time]] that the Empire was engaging the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the ''New Star'' was assigned to accompany [[Shipment 1037]], a [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] of over ten [[Transport/Legends|transports]], to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. During the escort duty, Conar brought along a platoon each of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and [[Imperial Navy Trooper/Legends|Imperial Navy troopers]] on his ship.<ref name="Orbit" />

{{RPGseed}}
While the frigate was on guard duty, its convoy was joined by [[Transport A-175]], along with the escort frigate ''[[Far Orbit]]'', near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]' [[Ringali Shell]]. The ''Far Orbit'' claimed that it had orders to accompany the convoy as well, a set of orders that Conar did not bother checking with [[Bormea Imperial Command]]. The ''Far Orbit'' also asserted that a new destination had been set to link up with an even larger escort force, as [[Imperial Navy Intelligence]] had uncovered a plot to intercept the convoy.<ref name="Orbit" />

However, as the convoy and the ''New Star'' arrived at the supposed rendezvous in the Ringali Shell with the escort force, they were [[Hijacking of Shipment 1037|attacked]] by an Alliance strike force, consisting of thirty-six [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]] and a pair of [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]], and turned on by the ''Far Orbit''. In actuality, the ''Far Orbit'' was an Alliance [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] vessel in disguise and had funneled the convoy into a trap. In the resulting [[Space warfare/Legends|battle]], the convoy was captured, as well as the ''New Star'', which was relatively undamaged. The privateers were awarded two million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for the capture of the ''New Star'' by the Alliance.<ref name="Orbit" />
{{Endgame}}

==Commanders and crew==
The ''New Star'' was commanded by Captain Miech Conar, a competent, intelligent leader who did not want to get [[Death/Legends|killed]] in a pointless battle between two ships. The frigate was also fully crewed by well trained ship hands and [[Officer/Legends|officers]].<ref name="Orbit" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''New Star'' first appeared in the adventure scenario ''[[The Hijacking of Shipment 1037]]'', which was published in ''[[The Far Orbit Project]]'', by [[Timothy S. O'Brien]]. The book was a supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' and was a sequel of sorts to the previous publication, ''[[Pirates & Privateers]]'', carrying on that book's theme by following the ''Far Orbit''{{'s}} adventures. In the adventure scenario, it is possible for the Alliance to not send any help for the ''Far Orbit'' in its attack on the convoy and the ''New Star'', leaving the ''Far Orbit'' to try to take the convoy alone. If that is the case, the ''Far Orbit'' might attempt to capture the ''New Star''. It is also possible for the ''New Star'' to be destroyed in the battle instead of being captured, in which case the privateers receive no money from the Alliance. If the ''New Star'' is captured but seriously damaged, the ''Far Orbit''{{'s}} crew is awarded a million credits. However, this article assumes that the course of events that this article presents is correct because they represent the best course of actions for the privateers, who are controlled by the players.<ref name="Orbit" />
